name: Juan Carlos
quote: It's everywhere: mysterious, powerful, calm, life everywhere.
about:
"I became a scuba instructor at 21, and a cave, cenote and shark dive guide in Cozumel before 23. I've taught diving in the Maldives, Indonesia and Guatemala, but the waters I know best are the Sea of Cortez.

I start every trip with questions: what's your name, where are you from, have you been in these waters before, what do you definitely want to experience? Then I plan around the answers. It's hard to stay tense when you're telling your own story."
history:
"Most recently, I sailed solo from Loreto to La Paz. Before that, I spent more than 30 days in a row as a deckhand on a liveaboard to the Socorro Islands.

I've led dive groups of up to eight in hard conditions, beginner divers and snorkelers, hiking and camping groups, and sailing charters as a guide and deckhand."
why:
"It started the first time I went diving, when someone told me I could do this for a living and travel the world.

What I love about sharing the sea fits in a list: intimacy, confidence, learning new skills, facing fears, unexpected encounters. And trust."
